title: no Wear Collection Service with miaomiao2
symptom: When using xDrip nightly versions from 2019.10.11 or later, a smartwatch (Sony SWR50, Huawei Watch 2 LTE) paired with a MiaoMiao2 transmitter does not receive data when the phone is not nearby; the watch sees the MM2 as a Limitter. Data works when the watch is connected to the phone.
cause: The thread suggests that newer versions of xDrip do not have access to the Wear API, as referenced from issue #374, which may prevent the watch from acting as a standalone collector.
fix: A user provided a link to a functional xDrip+ version for MM2 on smartwatches, and advised to pair the watch to the MM2. However, this is not an official fix and the issue was closed due to inactivity.
evidence_quote: It seems your vesion from 13/04/2019 works fine! And the new versions don't have access to Wear API.
